fields.name: event
fields.description: The conference, as it named itself, for example Plone Conference 2021 or Plone Tagung 2023.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: `global` for the annual Plone Conference, `regional` for every other conference.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Keynote, Talk or Panel, as the programme calls it; lightning-talk sessions are not recorded.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title of the talk, as the programme gives it.

fields.name: speakers
fields.description: The ids of the speakers in the people register. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: organisations
fields.description: The ids of the organisations in the organisations register, for a talk that the programme attributes to a team instead of people. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: video
fields.description: The web address of the recording, when one exists; one link, a second part goes to the notes.

fields.name: source
fields.description: A public record, linked as a web address, that supports the row: the programme or schedule page, the speaker page or the recording.
